peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 18.3% above its local comparables; 125 of 144 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (37.4): 2.4 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 147 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 9). Context, not scored: resales in 45.8% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $2,650,000 ($2,565 psf, 1,022–1,108 sq ft; 5 resales, Jan 2024–Dec 2025); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,066 psf (range $1,968–4,061); 24.2% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $516,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $3,800,000 ($2,532 psf, 1,334–1,765 sq ft; 7 resales, Aug 2024–Jul 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,253 psf (range $2,141–2,688); 12.4% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $419,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Napier MRT about 810 m, Orchard Boulevard MRT about 970 m; closer than 21 of 551 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest Queenstown Primary School about 1,020 m; more than 0 of 551 similar developments (the same as 106). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 4 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 790 m), more than 121 of 551 similar developments (the same as 48); nearest hawker centre Margaret Drive Hawker Centre about 1,240 m; nearest park Camp Road Interim Park about 350 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 5 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Penrith, 457 new sales, about 890 m; Upperhouse at Orchard Boulevard, 47 new sales, about 970 m; Park Nova, 4 new sales, about 1,190 m; Grange 1866, 6 new sales, about 1,510 m; 21 Anderson, 6 new sales, about 1,970 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 189 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 520 new sales and 842 resales (1,362 purchases); new sales were 38.2% of these purchases. Subsales (25) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 842 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 190 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 842 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 986 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−14.6%). Planning-area private resales −14%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
